description: This file defines a controller class 'FollowersController' for managing follower relationships within a web application using ASP.NET Core. It includes endpoints for following and unfollowing user profiles, utilizing dependency injection with MediatR for command handling, and applies authorization policies.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling follow and unfollow actions for user profiles.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to follow a user profile identified by username.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to unfollow a user profile identified by username.
